summary: Show the actual workflow-group total and append reviewer-requested bounded pages instead of silently treating the first 500 groups as complete.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and email content
User /ponytail instruction to reuse open-source and existing code instead of adding custom infrastructure
